description: This file defines the implementation of the NetworkDelegate class, including its destructor, various notification methods related to URL requests, headers, redirects, cookies, privacy, and reporting, as well as static methods for cookie management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: NetworkDelegate
classes.description: A class that handles network request lifecycle events and cookie management, used within Chromium's networking stack.

methods.name: ~NetworkDelegate
methods.description: Destructor for NetworkDelegate, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: NotifyBeforeURLRequest
methods.description: Called before a URL request is initiated.

methods.name: NotifyHeadersReceived
methods.description: Called when headers are received for a request.

methods.name: NotifyResponseStarted
methods.description: Called when a response has started.

methods.name: NotifyCompleted
methods.description: Called when a request is completed.

methods.name: NotifyURLRequestDestroyed
methods.description: Called when a URL request is destroyed.

methods.name: NotifyPACScriptError
methods.description: Called when there is a PAC script error.

methods.name: AnnotateAndMoveUserBlockedCookies
methods.description: Annotates and moves user-blocked cookies based on request.

methods.name: CanSetCookie
methods.description: Determines if a cookie can be set for a request.

methods.name: ForcePrivacyMode
methods.description: Determines privacy mode for a request.

methods.name: CancelURLRequestWithPolicyViolatingReferrerHeader
methods.description: Cancels a request if referrer policy is violated.

methods.name: CanQueueReportingReport
methods.description: Checks if a reporting report can be queued.

methods.name: CanSendReportingReports
methods.description: Checks if reporting reports can be sent.

methods.name: CanSetReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be set.

methods.name: CanUseReportingClient
methods.description: Checks if a reporting client can be used.

methods.name: GetFirstPartySetsCacheFilterMatchInfoMaybeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves cache filter match info asynchronously.
